chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: The Laura Bowman Players at Music Town
summary: Spikes mostly rented the hall but produced shows with actress Laura Bowman, formerly of the Lafayette Players, with dancer Wesley Gale in the cast of Salome.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How about, did you present musical...jam sessions or dances or anything there?

SPIKES - 145
Reel 4
Page 39
No, not dances or anything. I always rented the 11. I was always doing the renting. But after I got Laura Bowman, she put on two, three shows, you know, of her own.
Yeah, I think uh...no, this one...
That's the one, there.

Oh, Laura Bowman Theat...Show...oh, this is Music Town, Yeah, this is Music Town--Music Town Showcase Theater, "Laura Bowman Players. B.F. 'Reb' Spikes, producer-manager. Laura Bowman, director." And then there's this picture...a nice picture... but you know, there's a slight resemblance to George Raft. This reminds me of a picture I've seen of George Raft.
Yeah, a lot of people used to say that.
But I think it looks like one of his publicity pictures--the particular pose. And the hat, of course. And the angle of the hat.
Well, you know, I just read in the paper today ...yesterday or the day before that he's very serious in the hospital.
Yeah, I read that, too. That's too bad. I understand that he's a very nice man, I've heard.
I imagine he is, yes. [inaudible]
And Ms. Bowman--she...she was from the East, wasn't she?
Yeah. She was a great actress.
Yeah, it gives her background here, and it is very impressive. She had been with the Lafayette Players, which I think we mentioned.

SPIKES - 146
Reel 4
Page 40
Oh, a long time. She was...and then she...her biggest cast character, I think, was in "Anna Lucasta." That was the last one she was in, I think--big travelling show.
I see, in this production of "Salome," that at the very bottom of the list of cast, the dancer is Wesley Gale. I know he's still around.
Yeah heh.
As an actor.
Yeah, he's a...
...character.
Yeah, I'm tellin' you! I think he's a...I think he's a gay! He's a...

You mean he was just as much of a character then? Oh, he is. Yes, yes. He was operating a little theater on Crenshaw, Argus? No, I can't think of the name of it. A few years ago, and he does some movie roles, you know.
Yeah. Yeah, I know. Those kind of guys get in a lot of places.
